classification.interpretation: The evidence supports more than one limitation: directed coverage changes the distance, but residual OOD and/or representation quality remain material.

rules.coverage_gap: directed PCA NN distance < broad distance and directed percentile + 10 < broad percentile
rules.mixed: more than one flag is material
rules.representation_gap: broad PCA percentile >= 95, confirmed-directed feature Q05-Q95 overlap >= 0.70, and directed nearest20 best mean NSE >= max(0.45, 0.90*broad best)

diagnostic_contrast_pool.use: diagnostic contrast only; never merged into A1/A2 training

definition.high_flow_frequency: fraction of daily values above broad pooled per-gauge Q95
definition.low_flow_frequency: fraction of daily values below broad pooled per-gauge Q05
definition.standardized_residual_reference: broad feature mean and sample standard deviation

nearest20.metric_source: persisted existing development qsim versus qobs; no new Real-SWAT run

pca_embedding.space: A1 frozen Ridge PCA on train-fitted GaugeFlowScaler(log1p), input stride=7

Knowledge-guided calibration V1/V2.proof: V1 extract_metrics calls r3.load_observed for development dates; V2 reuses V1 metrics/objective.

R1_1000 calibration.proof: OBSERVED clean_csv + load_observed(2003-2016) + objective(mean development NSE).

R2 calibration.proof: OBSERVED clean_csv + load_observed(2003-2016) + fitness from three-gauge NSE.

R4_FAST_2048 calibration.proof: R4 calls the inherited R3 evaluate_output, whose objective reads development qobs.

historical_maximin_farthest_point.proof: Standardized historical runner loads development observations and persists qobs-based metrics.json.
